evidence: 2D and 3d_top show visible gaps between all bodies, including the tight C1/R9/R10 cluster beside U1 and roughly 1.5-2 mm between the lowest channel passive and each screw-terminal body.

Screw terminals J1-J4 sit on the bottom edge with wire openings facing outward and nothing between body and edge (3d_iso/3d_top), and J5 is a vertical top-entry header near the top edge with clear surroundings.
All four analog channels use an identical vertical C-D-R-R strip with components forming aligned rows (C2-C5, D1-D4, R2/R4/R6/R8, R1/R3/R5/R7) at even column spacing over their terminals.

The R10, R9 and C1 designators beside U1 are stacked directly on top of one another and over the footprints, making them mutually overlapping and illegible, while channel designators elsewhere are clean.

The upper-left and upper-right regions of the board are large dead zones with only J5 floating mid-board, while U1's support passives are crammed into one tiny congested cluster, so area use is disproportionate.
